rules.name: combined-var-02-slices-uat
rules.sql: SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT subportfolio) AS subportfolios, count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code) AS products, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date, min(settlement_date) AS min_settle_date, max(settlement_date) AS max_settle_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE future_continuation_series IS NULL OR future_continuation_series = '') AS no_future_series, count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND option_continuation_series <> '') AS option_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(delta, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(gamma, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(vega, 0) = 0) AS all_greeks_zero FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report GROUP BY tenant_id, business_unit ORDER BY tenant_id, business_unit

SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, status, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) AS levels, count(DISTINCT subportfolio) AS subportfolios FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table GROUP BY tenant_id, business_unit, status ORDER BY tenant_id, business_unit, status

WITH acct AS ( SELECT subportfolio, value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu ), agg AS ( SELECT DISTINCT aggregation_level, subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM acct) AS acct_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT subportfolio) FROM acct) AS acct_subportfolios, (SELECT count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) FROM agg) AS agg_levels, (SELECT count(DISTINCT subportfolio) FROM agg) AS agg_subportfolios, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE subportfolio IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM agg)) AS acct_rows_in_agg, (SELECT count(DISTINCT subportfolio) FROM acct WHERE subportfolio IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM agg)) AS acct_subportfolios_in_agg

SELECT a.subportfolio, count(*) AS row_count, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g.status, ',') FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table g WHERE g.subportfolio = a.subportfolio AND LOWER(g.business_unit) = :bu) AS status_in_agg_table, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g.business_unit, ',') FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table g WHERE g.subportfolio = a.subportfolio) AS bus_in_agg_table FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a WHERE LOWER(a.business_unit) = :bu AND a.subportfolio NOT IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY a.subportfolio ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 50

WITH fs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT future_continuation_series AS s FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND future_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND future_continuation_series <> '' ), os AS ( SELECT DISTINCT option_continuation_series AS s FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = :bu AND option_continuation_series IS NOT NULL AND option_continuation_series <> '' ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fs) AS future_series, (SELECT count(*) FROM fs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.var_cont_price_change_table p WHERE p.cont_month = fs.s)) AS future_series_with_price, (SELECT count(*) FROM os) AS option_series, (SELECT count(*) FROM os WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.var_cont_vol_change_table v WHERE v.cont_month = os.s)) AS option_series_with_vol

expect.reason: the accounting table is not empty overall (2447 rows seen in step 1)
the aggregation table is not empty overall (31572 rows seen in step 1)
the CFS accounting slice must hold rows, otherwise there is nothing to report
the CFS ACTIVE aggregation slice must hold levels, otherwise the report has no rows
accounting rows must match an aggregation subportfolio or they are dropped
